html:
Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Ebony Maw has commenced attack after gaining even more sinister powers!
Agents, it’s time to utilize his powerful telekinesis!

 

After the 6/9 maintenance,
try out Ebony Maw’s new uniform
and advance him to Tier-3!

 

■ 6/9 Maintenance Notice

 

* The game will not be available during the 6/9 maintenance.
After the maintenance, a separate Build Version Upgrade will not be required.
The game will be available after downloading the new data.
* There will be stabilization improvements during the maintenance. Due to this process, we are undergoing maintenance instead of a patch. 
We at MARVEL Future Fight are always working hard to provide a better service!
Thank you for your understanding.

 

 

▣ 1 New Uniform
 
Ebony Maw’s <Dark Obsidian Armor> will be available for purchase after the maintenance.
* New Uniform Skills are based on Skill Level 6 stats. 
   There have been some changes to the Uniform’s stats and options since the May update, so please check out the details below.
* The new Uniform will be available for purchase after the 6/9 maintenance, 
   and the All Uniforms 40% Sale Event will be applied.
* The new uniform will be available for purchase in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform List.

 

 

▣ Ebony Maw Tier-3 Ultimate Skill

 

You can advance Ebony Maw to Tier-3 after the maintenance!


 

 

▣ Other Improvements

 

1. Supergiant <Dark Obsidian Armor>’s Active Skill #4 ‘Puppet Control’ has been buffed. 
Increases Skill damage by 50% and increases Bonus Damage by 50%. (5 Sec.) -> (6 Sec.)
 
2. World Boss Quicksilver Challenge Unlock - Giant Slayer - Clear Supergiant 5 times.
Defeating Supergiant Ultimate will also count towards the total clear count for the Giant Slayer Challenge.
 

[6/10 1:24 a.m. (UTC+0), 6/9 6:24 p.m. (PDT) added]

 

3. Scarlet Witch <WandaVision>'s Active Skill #4 'Chaos Awakened' has been improved.
Before: Mind Control (2 Sec.), damage received increased by +6% (2 Sec.).
After: Mind Control (4 Sec.), damage received increased by +6% (4 Sec.).

 

 
▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. During the maintenance, the issue with the 28 Day Check-In event will be fixed.﻿
 
 [Details]

 

[6/9 5:31 a.m. (UTC+0), 6/8 10:31 p.m. (PDT) added]

 

Further notice on the 28 Day Check-In event
 
Agents who will achieve 7 days of attendeance through the Day4 and Day 5 fix,
and are to recieve the bonus reward, Custom Gear Chest: ★6,
will be subject to the following measure.

 

※ The Custom Gear Chest: ★6 will be sent to the Inbox.
This item will be stored for 7 days, so please receive it within the period.

 

2. Compensation will be provided to those Agents who were unable to receive Timed Items due to the 5/26 Emergency Maintenance.

 

* Target Agents: Agents who had the effects of the items listed below applied during 5/26 7:07 a.m. (UTC+0)/ 5/26 12:07 a.m. (PDT) - Emergency Maintenance, and have not logged in for 
5/25 3:00 p.m. - 5/26 2:59 p.m. (UTC+0), 
5/25 8:00 a.m. - 5/26 7:59 a.m. (PDT), 
will be rewarded with the following items.
 
* Agents who have used two or more rewards that came from Combine Fragments - Story Ultimate before the Emergency Maintenance will not be able to receive the compensation.
 
* Target Items and Rewards:

 

* The rewards will be sent to the Inbox and will expire in 7 days. 

 

[6/9 6:26 a.m. (UTC+0), 6/8 11:26 p.m. (PDT) added]

 

When checking the Inbox, the rewards 'Get 20 X-GENES DAILY', and 'DAILY RANK UP MATERIAL' will not display exactly how much material that the Agents are going to receive. 

However, Agents will be able to properly receive 20 materials for both of the rewards.

 

[6/9 3:16 a.m. (UTC+0), 6/8 8:16 p.m. (PDT) added]

 

Further notice on a missing Target Item

 

- Target Item: 1 Year Crystal Bundle
- Target Agents: Those who purchased the 1 Year Crystal Bundle but have not logged in during, 5/25 3:00 p.m. - 5/26 2:59 p.m. (UTC+0), 5/25 8:00 a.m. - 5/26 7:59 a.m. (PDT)
- Reward: 15 Crystals sent to the Inbox


 
3. Items that expired due to not being able to log in during the 5/26 Emergency Maintenance and the 5/27 Suspension Lift will be restored.
* Agents who have been suspended due to the use of two or more rewards received from Combine Fragments - Story Ultimate before the Emergency Maintenance will not be able to receive the compensation.
* Restored items will expire in 7 days.

 
4. The issue regarding Phyla Vell <Modern>’s Tier-2 Passive ‘Quantum Energy Amplification’ has been fixed.

 - The skill effects ‘Skill Damage Increase and Bonus Damage Increase’ of Controlled Chaos and Quantum Energy Amplification were applied in turns when playing with Scarlet Witch <Wanda Vision> while Phyla Vell was a member of the team.
→ The issue was fixed by applying Scarlet Witch’s skill Controlled Chaos effect ‘Skill Damage Increase and Bonus Damage Increase’ first instead of being applied in turns when going into battle with Scarlet Witch.
     
  - When Quantum Energy Amplification skill effect ‘30% increase of All Attacks’, is overlapped with an ISO-8 Set Bonus effect that has ‘x% increase of All Attacks’, only one of the effects are applied when going into battle. 
→ The issue is to be fixed by applying the Quantum Energy Amplification skill effect ‘x% increase of All Attacks’ before going into battle on the My Team screen, therefore not overlapping with the ISO-8 Set Bonus effect.


Exercise Ebony Maw’s powers 
to gain an advantage in future battles!

 

Thank you.
